query:
SELECT
            c.id,
            c.org_id
        FROM caches c
        WHERE c.retention_days IS NOT NULL
            AND EXISTS(
                SELECT 1
                FROM published_paths p
                WHERE p.cache_id = c.id
                    AND p.last_pushed_at < now() - c.retention_days * INTERVAL '1 day'
                    AND NOT nix_path_pinned(p.cache_id, p.store_path_hash, now())
            )
        ORDER BY c.id
        LIMIT $1
